trial_court: Court of Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Hisar, Criminal Case No. 1067-1 of 03.09.08
case_name: Santosh Pandey Son Of Late Sh. Jai ... vs State Of Haryana

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Santosh Pandey son of Late Sh. Jai Parkash; Smt. Bindevasini Devi, wd/o late Sh. Jai Parkash; Vijay Pandey son of Sh. Jai Parkash; Smt. Mala Devi wife of Sh. Vijay Pandey
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Haryana; Smt. Babita, d/o Sh. Ganesh Mishra, r/o Gali No. 25, Surya Nagar, Hisar

facts_of_case: The marriage of Babita was solemnized with Santosh Pandey on 28.01.07. The petitioners started teasing and harassing the complainant for bringing less dowry. They pressurized her to bring more dowry, but when she showed inability, she was given severe beatings.

legal_principles.principle: At the time of deciding a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the Court is not required to go into the probable defence of the accused.
legal_principles.held: The Court is only required to take consideration as to whether the allegations contained in the complaint were sufficient to constitute the offences or not.

outcome.final_order: The petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., for quashing the complaint, is allowed.
